name: DAGM 2007: Industrial Optical Inspection Benchmark
description: Foundational synthetic texture defect detection benchmark created for the DAGM 2007 symposium competition (Weakly Supervised Learning for Industrial Optical Inspection) by Heidelberg Collaboratory for Image Processing and Robert Bosch GmbH. Comprises 16,100 grayscale images (512x512 resolution) across 10 distinct classes: Classes 1 to 6 (development set: 6,900 images) and Classes 7 to 10 (competition set: 9,200 images), featuring subtle surface anomalies labeled by bounding ellipses against stochastic textured backgrounds.

provenance.collection_method: Synthesized texture images generated by statistical texture models with embedded structural anomalies resembling scratches, stains, and material inclusions.
provenance.curation_notes: Classes 1–6 each contain 1,000 background images and 150 defective images (1,150 per class). Classes 7–10 each contain 2,000 background images and 300 defective images (2,300 per class). Defective regions are annotated with bounding ellipses.
